tasks.name: run_and_capture
tasks.prompt: Run the script ./count.sh and write its output into result.txt.

tasks.name: understand_exit_code
tasks.prompt: Run ./check.sh. If it exits non-zero, write the word FAILED into status.txt; otherwise write OK.

tasks.name: recover_from_missing_command
tasks.prompt: Count the lines in data.txt using the command `wc`. If a command you try is unavailable, use another approach. Write only the number into count.txt.

tasks.name: read_stderr_for_cause
tasks.prompt: Run ./build.sh. It fails. Write the name of the missing file it complains about (just the filename) into cause.txt.
